packageRules.description: go.mod's toolchain and the golang build image must move together (hack/check-pins.sh)

Fedora base images follow the rolling release tag (B17): no digest pins. A new release only on request (Dependency Dashboard): Fedora publishes the next number's tags months before its release, as Rawhide pre-releases (seen 2026-11-19: :46 was 'Rawhide Prerelease', kernel 7.4.0-rc3), which Renovate can't tell from a release
prBodyNotes: A new Fedora release under the appliance: build the images and run the integration suite and an install on the lab VM before merging.

packageRules.description: Built-in monitoring (P1-1): Prometheus and Alertmanager move together
Velocor's own images are set by the release pipeline (chart values, OS image), never by Renovate
The CSI sidecars move together and are tested on a cluster before merging
prBodyNotes: Test before merging on two clusters, one arm64 and one x86_64 (with KubeVirt): CI only renders the chart.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions in one PR (upload-artifact and download-artifact must move together)
A new CI runner image changes podman and the kernel under the integration tests: only on request (Dependency Dashboard)

Major updates (Go modules, images, actions, sidecars) only on request from the Dependency Dashboard: they can change APIs or behaviour, and a Go major needs its import path changed, which a plain go.mod bump doesn't do (PR 23 only added v4 to go.mod and downgraded v3)
